stem: Throughout the High Middle Ages, the English government became increasingly ____: the document produced in the eleventh century could be placed on one large table, while the documents produced in the thirteenth fill whole rooms.

It is unfortunate that essays by literary critics so infrequently (i)____ the opinions of novelists and poets, for creative writers are often quite (ii)____ about their own philosophies and are frequently more familiar with alternative systems of thought than critics are.
colsZh: 明白清晰地表述；表达清晰的

stem: At one time researchers viewed the placebo effect as (i)____, a statistical (ii)____ faced by those attempting an objective evaluation of the efficacy of potentially legitimate therapies. That view has changed: the placebo effect is today seen as an important part of the healing process.

The lack of (i)____ the poetry of the postwar decades has led not, as one might have expected, to (ii)____ poetry, but to a curious closure in which all poets and forms of poetry are (iii)____ and alone, not even respected establishment poets.
Orbiting Jupiter just beyond Europa, the giant moon Ganymede—bigger than the planet Mercury —appears rather ____ on the outside, but it may be warm and active within.
optsZh: （人）懒惰缺乏活力的；（物品）惰性的

stem: Although the use of cameras to study animal behavior was certainly not ____, cameras were nevertheless not used to study individual frogs in their natural habitat until 2009.

In nineteenth-century Puerto Rico, the consumption of salted cod spread among the entire population; on the tables of humbler families it became ____ food, adding flavor to other products and supplying much-needed protein.
